definition: An individual or organisation receiving energy services from the company.
A unique identifier assigned to each customer.
The category assigned to a customer based on the type of customer account.
The current operational status of a customer account.
The email address associated with a customer account and used for customer communication.
A billing record representing charges issued to a customer for energy services.
The monetary amount charged to a customer on an invoice.
The date associated with the issuance of an invoice.
The current payment state associated with an invoice.
A device used to measure energy consumption.
The category assigned to an energy meter.
The current operational status of an energy meter.
A recorded energy consumption observation associated with a meter.
The quantity of energy consumed over a defined period.
An energy pricing plan defining how energy consumption is charged.
The business-facing name assigned to an energy tariff.
The type of energy product to which a tariff applies.
The monetary charge applied per unit of energy consumption under a tariff.
